description: Calculate a Vedic birth chart (D1, sidereal) with Moon Dasha: the ascendant and the nine grahas with sign, degree, whole-sign house, nakshatra and pada, nakshatra lord, dignity, sign lord and the planet's relationship to it, retrograde, combust, Vargottama and Bhavottama flags, and chara karakas (7-karaka scheme), plus a link to the full chart on moondasha.com. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place). If the person does not know the birth time, ask for a best guess and set time_is_approximate. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

chart_style.description: How the chart card draws the chart: North Indian (default) or South Indian. Set south only when the person asks for it.

node.description: Rahu and Ketu by the mean node (default) or the true node.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned for the birthplace.

time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Required: if the person does not know it, ask for their best guess and set time_is_approximate.

time_is_approximate.description: Set when the birth time is a guess: the answer then shows the ascendant an hour either side.

name: birth_chart
title: Birth chart
